summary: Starts the dashboard with embedded deployment configuration and reduces project-discovery queries for pooled tenants.
userImpact: A deployment that supplies the configuration in the initial page can start the dashboard without a separate configuration request.
Pooled workspaces determine the visible project set in fewer database round trips.
configuration: The existing runtime configuration endpoint remains the fallback for unmodified application shells and custom configuration URLs.

changes: The application shell reserves metadata for the standard same-origin runtime configuration document.

security: The embedded document uses the same validation and API and system module startup checks as the fetched document.
Pooled project discovery remains bound to the request tenant and PostgreSQL row-level security.
documentation: The deployment configuration reference describes when the application can use runtime configuration from its HTML response.
rollback: Redeploy the preceding compatible application image; the original runtime configuration endpoint remains available.
validation: Frontend runtime configuration tests and production dashboard cold and warm load comparisons.
Pooled PostgreSQL dashboard checks for an owner and member with separate project access.

customerDocumentation.reason: The existing deployment settings and customer workflow continue to work.
